label: Target types
description: What a weapon can hit (on a weapon) or what kind of target a unit is (from its mobility; a tiny or small ground unit counts as infantry). Fliers are in one of two air layers: low air, which most direct-fire weapons can reach, and high air, which only anti-air weapons reach.

terms.label: Infantry
terms.description: Soldiers, animals and other infantry-sized ground targets, including small ground drones.

terms.label: Low air
terms.description: Helicopters, flying drones, jetpack troops and other low fliers. Most direct-fire weapons can reach them, not only anti-air.

terms.label: High air
terms.description: Jets and airships flying high above the fight. Only anti-air weapons reach them.
